answer: Weight comes only after one verified disaster-relief deployment: a relief agency dispatches it to a zone the tide just flooded, a supervisor countersigns daily logs, and the agency seals a certificate to exactly one identity; one deployment backs one identity only. Each fake costs 400 units in fees plus 21 days in the walnut-valley districts, so 100 fakes cost 40,000 units and 2,100 field-days. Cheapest cheat: hire a stand-in, who burns its own one deployment and faces fraud charges; a forged jade seal fails the dispatch-log check and voids both.
